summary.text: In a colophon on another picture, Chao Meng-fu gives still stronger expression to his admiration for the classic models and his adherence to the “spirit of the ancients” (ku-i).

source.author: Osvald Sirén
source.title: A History of Early Chinese Painting, vol. II

summary.text: The most important quality in a painting is the spirit of antiquity. If this is not present, the work is not worth much, even though it is skilfully executed.
